# **Public engagement & outreach**

- Activity facilitator at ‘Meeting the Microbes’ BRC outreach event at Vancouver Science World (2025)

- Coproduction of a press release on (Green et al, 2024, PLOS biology) for the Manchester University news site (https://shorturl.at/RDMoM). This was picked up by multiple news and popular science sites including: msn.com, phys.org, ddw-online.com, drugscontrol.org, psychreg.org, azolifesciences.com and myscience.org

- Activity facilitator at Manchester Community Festival ‘You & Your Microbes’ (2022-2024)

- Delivery of hands-on primary school workshops on enzyme action and the cells that make our bodies for Science Week (2023)

- Public talk for ‘Pint of Science’ festival titled ‘Antibiotic Resistance: The Deadly Power of Evolution’ (2022)
